//: rootDir='..' keeps the relative ../src/... import graph in the emitted JS. We do NOT glob the engine dir (that pulls in __tests__, scripts, and the browser-only hand-history.ts/IndexedDB); instead tsc follows imports from functions/src, compiling ONLY the engine files the functions actually use. noUnusedLocals is off because the shared engine is linted by the main vite build, not here.
